title: ST++: Make Self-training Work Better for Semi-supervised Semantic Segmentation
mechanism: Score each unlabelled image's reliability by how much saved checkpoints disagree on it. Retrain on the reliable images first. Use strong aug on unlabelled images.
adaptation: Rank pool cells by prediction agreement across the 5 seeds or checkpoints. Drop the least stable half (scuff, odd contrast, multi half-cells) before the NS or MIC arms. A cheap filter for an out-of-distribution pool.
min_experiment: NS-12k with the top-50% stable pool vs NS-12k with the full pool, 5 seeds. Metric: crack IoU and E1 relF1@2. Kill if n.d.
evidence: R: Pascal / Cityscapes SSL gains reported over plain self-training; numbers not in the abstract.
prior_overlap: Image-level selection was not used in our Mean Teacher runs (pixel thresholds only). Open, as an add-on.
